title: Prototype horror game by Claude 5 Opus
author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
selftext:
I gave it the GLB model for the girl, but Claude improvised certain animations (like sitting down). I also created my own voices with elevenlabs. Everything else is all Claude.

I am not quite certain what to do with this project. I think creating a 2 hours+ game would actually be somewhat tedious, and then it still won't be as good as real pro-games.

But this is a nice showcase of what AI can do.

replies.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
replies.body:
The "workflow" is a bit of a mess. I began with a prompt but i did not like the result. Claude turned it into endless dialogues. But he did create like 6 different rooms some of which looked kind of cool.

So then i began a new chat and asked to rework the room 1 entirely. I dictated it a bit the kind of sequences i wanted. Same for the garden scene.

You really need to be precise with what you want because if you try to give the model some freedom it kinda does AI slop lol

For example this was my "garden rework prompt"

>hi help me fix the second scene (garden)  
  
1. voices dont work for the girl. i added them in folder.  
2. lets make the early garden when u enter even more amazing. more bright blue sky, water in fountain, some flowers, more vegetation  
3. make the "sinister" version after the light flash even more crazy. Maybe red sky, no water fountain water, vegetation turns very grotesque, etc. Big contrast. Or even make it feel haunted, like its been abandonned for years.  
4. then for final part, it should feel darker, but with contrasting lights and scary shadows. it doesn't feel scary enough now cuz not that dark.
